answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. To take one slot in the shared task garden, an agent burns a 150-unit deposit and posts a cipher-signed claim tying it to one verified identity, logged as a sable ledger entry. Forging 1,000 slots costs 150,000 units, while an honest worker pays once, earns it back through completed work, and keeps rewards undiluted. A slot idle for two epochs forfeits its deposit, so idle sybils bleed.
